wholePhysicalScope: Native cathedral pentagon and Rua São Sebastião signed frontage. The parish identifies an east-facing triangular gable and three folded side bays.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the tent-shaped gable, folded nave roof and low entry canopy. Closer levels add the diagonal glass grille, bronze edging and roof seams.
limitations: The model represents the modern Santa Helena cathedral as photographed in June 2010, with the weathered tan frontage of that date.

The named outline and street constrain the plan. The original photograph controls the broad glass triangle, geometric grille, warm roof edging and lower porch. Side fold proportions and rear openings are reconstructed estimates based on the parish description.
The original Terrarium field is preserved. The terrace and paving contact are approximate.
